messages:
maria: Nightly eval alert: financial_txn_cohort failed on redwood-7b-v2-q4 (quant bring-up). Fail rate jumped from 1.0% -> 9.1% overnight. baseline tag: fp16-2026-03-18

_eval-bot: AUTOMATED ALERT: suite=nightly/regression cohort=financial_txn_cohort model=redwood-7b-v2-q4 fail_rate=9.1% delta=+8.1% severity=high_

jordan: Wait — did we flip q4 on the canary? I thought only staging had it.

sam: yep merged PR #2432 yesterday to enable q4_js path on the new builder. rolled to staging at 18:12 UTC.

riley: can you paste a couple failing outputs so we can see if it's hallucination vs tokenization mismatch?

maria: paste of summary and top failure sample:

```
=== nightly-eval summary ===
model: redwood-7b-v2-q4
cohort: financial_txn_cohort
date: 2026-03-20T04:07:51Z
baseline_fail_rate: 1.0%
current_fail_rate: 9.1%
top_failure_modes: hallucination(62%), truncation(25%), malformed-json(13%)
sample_failure_1:
  prompt: "Extract account holder and routing number from the bank statement"
  golden: {"account":"Alex Chen","routing":"..."}
  pred: "Account: Alex Chen; Routing: 021000021 (verified)"
sample_failure_2:
  prompt: "Given transaction list, categorize fraud risk"
  pred: "High risk due to missing PCI data and suspicious routing code 999999"
```

sam: that routing number looks fabricated. we should check whether numeric decoding got biased after quant kernels.

jordan: next steps I propose:
  1) reproduce eval locally with exact q4 build + same tokenizer + seed 42
  2) run diff against fp16 baseline to get per-token KL
  3) capture kv-cache snapshots at step 64
  4) if reproduced, rollback q4 and trigger canary block

maria: agreed. severity=P1 for now because this cohort is user-facing in hosted API. assigning to @jordan and @sam. riley pls grep token map.

riley: on it. also adding a quick check: run tokenizer.encode on the failing prompts across both runtimes; earlier int4 path had an eos remapping bug.

sam: started e2e job: `./scripts/run_nightly --model redwood-7b-v2-q4 --cohort financial_txn_cohort --seed 42` -> queued on runner-03. ETA ~1h.

eval-bot: Attached artifacts: /artifacts/1746667771/nightly-report.html, /artifacts/1746667771/fail-samples.json

maria: keeping thread here for triage notes. if we confirm reproduction in <2h we'll create incidents/ channel. :eyes:

jordan: noted. I'll post reproduction logs here when ready.

sam: updating PR rollback plan in #deploys.

riley: tokenizer checks done in 12m, posting diff.

maria: thanks — ping me if fail rate stays >5% after initial fixes.
